name: EIA Electricity Generation Dashboard
description: Descriptive dashboard blueprint, not an importable Metabase export or a copy of the verified synthetic-fixture dashboard. Display and parameter fields describe a proposed layout; filters are not wired or verified. The fixture dashboard uses a fuel table because latest-month shares are NULL. Monthly net electricity generation (EIA Form 923, API v2): leaf-only aggregates exclude rollup geographies and aggregate fuels per docs/data-model.md section 4. NULL differs from zero; finite negatives are valid.

ordered_cards.description: Total monthly generation (MWh) from leaf geographies only. Proposed filters: period, location, sector, fuel; parameter mappings are not implemented.
Bar chart of top 20 states/regions by total MWh over the last 12 months.
Proposed pie chart only when latest-month shares are defined. The verified fixture dashboard uses a table and does not present NULL shares as percentages.
Bar chart of generation by EIA sector over the last 12 months.

Leaf-side sum vs the US+ALL all-sectors reconciliation total. Complete national data should reconcile within 0.01 MWh. The synthetic fixture is incomplete; July differs, and the query INNER JOIN omits June/August without source totals.
Multi-line chart of monthly generation by sector over the last 24 months.
